facts.fact: 塔拉辛当上女王后的第一个小时，待在父亲埃拉格比的书房里拼凑外祖母最后时刻的经过。
facts.anchor: Talasyn spent her first hour as queen in Prince Elagbi’s study, piecing together her grandmother’s last moments.

facts.fact: 冰做的王冠被冲上海滩后寻回，已经残破、半熔化。
facts.anchor: the icy crown had been recovered, having washed up on the beach, battered and half-melted.

facts.fact: 乌尔杜佳身边多数效忠派议事成员随她一同丧命。
facts.anchor: Most of Urduja’s loyalist council had perished with her.

facts.fact: 乌尔杜佳女王嘱咐她：一旦出事，先查清谁最先离开。
facts.anchor: Queen Urduja told me to find out who left first if anything happened

facts.fact: 乌尔杜佳在次日下午日落时分安葬于埃斯卡亚的星光塔。
facts.anchor: Urduja was laid to rest in Eskaya’s Starlight Tower at sunset of the following afternoon.

facts.fact: 数根细长的毒针从王冠那轮小太阳里被抽出。
facts.anchor: several long, thin needles were extracted from their hiding places inside that miniature sun

facts.fact: 吉被从母亲领地召回，为新任女王女侍的身份满心骄傲。
facts.anchor: Jie had been recalled from her mother’s domain and was brimming with pride in the new position of Her Majesty’s lady-in-waiting.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛以谋杀乌尔杜佳·西利姆的罪名正式指控她。
facts.anchor: I charge her with the murder of Urduja Silim.
